s: Located at the center of the old Lhasa, Jokhang Temple (Chinese Name: 大昭寺) is the spiritual center of Tibet. Built in 647 by Songtsen Gampo, it has a history of more than 1,300 years. The temple is the fine product of Han, Tibetan and Nepalese architecture techniques.

t: Jokhang Temple: The Most Sacred Monastery in Tibet
s: Jokhang Temple, also known as Zuglagkang, Qoikang Monastery (Buddha Hall in Tibetan), and Jokhang Monastery, is considered the spiritual heart of Lhasa city and the most sacred monastery in Tibet due to the status of Jowo Rinpoche. The Jokhang is 1,000 meters (3,300 ft) southeast of the Potala Palace, in the center of the old city of Lhasa.
